caption: The drawing depicts a pair of women's shoes positioned side by side, both facing towards the lower left corner of the image. The shoes are predominantly green with a glossy finish, reflecting highlights that suggest a shiny material. Each shoe features a strap across the top and a squared-off toe box that is brown with a texture resembling woven or patterned material. The shoes have low, slightly curved heels and are outlined with fine black lines. The interior of the shoes is white, with no visible insole details. The background of the drawing is plain, with a light beige color and no additional objects or patterns, emphasizing the shoes as the central focus of the composition.
title: Woman's Shoes
